title: Online Discussion & Netiquette
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Week 1 Study sheet pp.1-6, Classwork, Homework, Revision

scenes.t: Yahia's class has a new online discussion. A discussion is when people talk together and share ideas, opinions or information about a topic.
An online discussion happens over the internet. People share their ideas using text, pictures or videos.
Online discussions help us learn together. We can ask questions, get answers, and get help when we are stuck.
We can also chat with friends and family, even if they are far away.
Even if you feel shy in class, you can type your thoughts online. Every child gets a voice!
Netiquette means being polite and respectful when we communicate online. It is internet manners.
Some netiquette rules: be polite, stay on topic, use proper grammar, respect people's privacy, and respect other opinions, even if you disagree.
Do not use ALL CAPITAL LETTERS. They look like shouting! And take time to think before you reply.
To respond positively, give a compliment, agree or disagree politely, and add to the conversation.
Two Stars and a Wish: say two good things, then make one wish, which is one idea to make it even better.

items.a: Sharing ideas with other people over the internet.
Saying something nice about what someone shared.
Saying I agree with you, and here is why.
Sharing your own idea to keep the discussion going.
Two good things, and one idea to improve.
